dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, have you ever been abroad?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, hæv juː ˈɛvər bɪn əˈbrɔːd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. I've been to Japan.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈhæv. aɪv bɪn tə dʒəˈpæn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Japan! Did you need a visa?
dialogue.reading: dʒəˈpæn! dɪd juː ˈniːd ə ˈviːzə?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I didn't. Thai people don't need a visa for Japan. Have you ever been to Laos?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdɪdənt. ˈtaɪ ˈpiːpəl ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd ə ˈviːzə fər dʒəˈpæn. hæv juː ˈɛvər bɪn tə ˈlaʊs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, I haven't. It's on my list. I want to visit more foreign countries in Asia.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈhævənt. ɪts ɑːn maɪ ˈlɪst. aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈvɪzɪt ˈmɔːr ˈfɔːrən ˈkʌntriz ɪn ˈeɪʒə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Have you ever traveled with only a backpack?
dialogue.reading: hæv juː ˈɛvər ˈtrævəld wɪð ˈoʊnli ə ˈbækpæk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, I have. A backpack is easier than a suitcase!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈhæv. ə ˈbækpæk ɪz ˈiːziər ðən ə ˈsuːtkeɪs!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Have you ever been to Ayutthaya? It's great for sightseeing.
dialogue.reading: hæv juː ˈɛvər bɪn tə ɑːˈjuːtəjə? ɪts ˈɡreɪt fər ˈsaɪtsiːɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, never. Is it far from Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈnɛvər. ɪz ɪt ˈfɑːr frəm ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it isn't. Let's go there together!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈɪzənt. ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ ˈðɛr təˈɡɛðər!
